answer.reason: The ark's story has two main events in the verses given: it bore Noah and the living creatures through the flood, and it came to rest on Ararat.

clauses.english: was entered by Noah, his family and the animals, and bore them up above the flood
clauses.quote: the waters increased, and bare up the ark, and it was lift up above the earth

clauses.english: rested upon the mountains of Ararat
clauses.quote: the ark rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, upon the mountains of Ararat

doubts: The building of the ark is already given in the summary, so it is not a clause.
The verses from Matthew, Luke, Hebrews and 1 Peter only refer back to the flood story, so they are not cited.
